en.introduction: Your electricity, at a glance. Open a meter for trends, market prices and energy-only estimates. Measurements are delayed; meters are not added together because their coverage may overlap. This dashboard is integration-managed. Copy its cards into your own dashboard to customize them.
en.delayed: Reported energy, not live power. The latest complete day may be several days old. Month/year figures include only reported readings.
en.awaiting_history: Waiting for historical readings. Import progress is shown below.
en.coverage: **Month coverage · reported / expected hours · covered through**
en.stale_warning: **Delayed or unavailable data.** Check the latest measurement and import status before interpreting totals.
en.price_basis: Wholesale spot prices · DKK/kWh excluding VAT, grid charges, taxes and supplier fees. Source: [Energinet DayAheadPrices](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/DayAheadPrices). Currency conversion may differ from your supplier.
en.unpublished: Prices are not yet published or coverage is incomplete. No missing interval is treated as zero.
en.configure_prices: Open Settings → Devices & services → El-Overblik HA → Configure. Select 'Configure market prices and contracts per meter', then choose DK1/DK2 and optionally enter your energy contract.
en.cost_basis: **Energy-only estimates, not your bill.** Excludes VAT, electricity taxes, grid charges and subscriptions. Each hour uses the average of its four spot prices, assuming uniform consumption within that hour. Positive difference = premium to wholesale; negative = discount. This is not a guaranteed saving.
en.configure_contract: Add an optional contract in the integration options to compare your energy rate with wholesale.
en.incomplete_energy: Waiting for a complete consumption day.
en.outside_contract: The latest complete consumption day predates these contract terms. No retroactive estimate is made.
en.unsupported_period: Market comparisons before 1 October 2025 are not supported.
en.incomplete_prices: Waiting for complete matching market prices. Automatic comparison history is limited to the last 31 days.
en.ready: Complete matching consumption and prices. Both amounts use the same energy and exclude VAT.
en.price_health: **Market prices last fetched · latest published interval end · source error (if any)**

da.introduction: Din strøm i overblik. Åbn et målepunkt for udvikling, markedspriser og estimater for ren energi. Målinger er forsinkede. Målepunkter lægges ikke sammen, da de kan overlappe. Dashboardet styres af integrationen. Kopiér kortene til dit eget dashboard for at tilpasse dem.
da.delayed: Rapporteret energi, ikke liveeffekt. Seneste komplette dag kan være flere dage gammel. Måneds-/årstal omfatter kun rapporterede målinger.
da.awaiting_history: Venter på historiske målinger. Se importstatus nedenfor.
da.stale_warning: **Forsinkede eller utilgængelige data.** Kontrollér seneste måling og importstatus, før du fortolker summer.
da.price_basis: Engrosspotpriser · DKK/kWh uden moms, nettariffer, afgifter og leverandørgebyrer. Kilde: [Energinet DayAheadPrices](https://www.energidataservice.dk/tso-electricity/DayAheadPrices). Valutaomregning kan afvige fra din leverandørs.
da.unpublished: Priserne er endnu ikke offentliggjort, eller dækningen er ufuldstændig. Manglende intervaller sættes ikke til nul.
da.configure_prices: Åbn Indstillinger → Enheder og tjenester → El-Overblik HA → Konfigurer. Vælg 'Indstil markedspriser og elaftale pr. målepunkt', vælg DK1/DK2 og indtast eventuelt din energipris.
da.cost_basis: **Estimat for ren energi, ikke din elregning.** Uden moms, elafgift, nettariffer og abonnement. Hver time anvender gennemsnittet af fire spotpriser med antaget jævnt forbrug. Positiv forskel = merpris mod engros; negativ = rabat. Ikke en garanteret besparelse.
da.configure_contract: Tilføj en valgfri elaftale i integrationsindstillingerne for at sammenligne din energipris med engros.
da.outside_contract: Seneste komplette forbrugsdag ligger før disse aftalevilkår. Der beregnes ikke bagudrettet.
da.incomplete_prices: Venter på komplette matchende markedspriser. Automatisk sammenligningshistorik er begrænset til de seneste 31 dage.
da.ready: Komplet matchende forbrug og priser. Begge beløb bruger samme energi og er uden moms.
da.price_health: **Markedspriser senest hentet · seneste offentliggjorte intervalslut · kildefejl (hvis nogen)**
